scenario: 今天的具身赛道在问，策略该在何时细算、何时跳过，失败了如何自己补救，以及训练信号不完整或扰动出现时，模型还能否按指令把动作做完。有的方法把时间分辨率写进监督，让策略在冗余运动上跃步、在接触处密修；有的把指令结构显式交给阶段指针，或让图像生成主干直接回归动作。思维链如果当成动作前缀会在推理时累积误差，抓取失败则需要力反馈来触发重试。动作标注有缺口、四足遇到未采样过的负载和地形、世界模型在闭环里反复重算相近动作，也都在逼策略把不完整信号和重复计算处理干净。点跟踪则开始有了专门面向操作场景的基准和训练数据。

papers.title: SkiP: When to Skip and When to Refine for Efficient Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Mingtong Dai, Guanqi Peng, Yongjie Bai, Feng yan, chunjie chen, Lingbo Liu, Liang Lin, Xinyu Wu
papers.abstract:
Previous imitation learning policies predict future actions at every control step, whether in smooth motion phases or precise, contact-rich operation phases.
This uniform treatment is wasteful: predictable free-space motion and precise contact-rich manipulation demand different temporal resolutions.
We partition demonstrations into \emph{key segments} requiring dense refinement and \emph{skip segments} containing temporally redundant motion.
We propose a novel \emph{action relabeling} mechanism: at each timestep in a skip segment, we replace the behavior cloning target with the action at the entrance of the next key segment, enabling the policy to leap over redundant steps in a single decision.
The resulting \textbf{Skip Policy (SkiP)} dynamically leaps over skip segments and intensively refines actions in key segments, within a single unified network requiring no learned skip planner or hierarchical structure.
To obtain this partition without manual annotation, we introduce \emph{Motion Spectrum Keying} (MSK), a fast, task-agnostic procedure that analyzes the local frequency structure of trajectory velocities.
Extensive experiments across 72 simulated manipulation tasks and three real-robot tasks show that SkiP reduces executed steps by $15$--$40\%$ while matching or improving success rates across various policy backbones. Project page: \texttt{https://pgq18.github.io/SkiP-page/}.
papers.summary: 模仿学习策略往往在每个控制步都预测未来动作，不管当时是可预见的空闲运动，还是必须精细处理的接触阶段，时间分辨率被当成一成不变的。一种跳过策略把演示划成需要密修的关键段和有时间冗余的可跳过段，并在可跳过段里把行为克隆目标改写成下一段关键段入口的动作。这样就能在同一个网络里直接跃过冗余步、在关键处细修，不必再学一个跳跃规划器。划分由运动谱关键点分析轨迹速度的局部频率自动完成，不用人工标注。在 72 个仿真操作任务和三项真机任务上，它把实际执行步数减少 15% 到 40%，成功率则持平或更好。==时间分辨率可以写在监督信号里，而不必另搭一套分层规划。==

papers.title: NS-VLA: Towards Neuro-Symbolic Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Ziyue Zhu, Shangyang Wu, Shuai Zhao, Zhao ZhiQiu, Jian Zhang, Li Shengjie, Yi Wang, Anh Tuan Luu, Xinliang Zhou, Fang Li, Haoran Luo
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models ground natural-language instructions in visual observations to generate actions for robotic manipulation. On long-horizon tasks, existing VLA models face structure-blind backbones, backbone-bound generalization, and flat single-objective optimization. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Neuro-Symbolic Vision-Language-Action (NS-VLA) framework. It introduces a Neuro-Symbolic Encoder that parses the instruction into a primitive plan tracked by a gated monotone stage pointer, a Neuro-Symbolic Solver that conditions a chunked VLA policy on the active sub-instruction, and Hierarchical Joint Policy Optimization, which fits the pointer on demonstration segments and refines the action policy with success-filtered online learning. Even when trained on few demonstrations, NS-VLA clearly leads on LIBERO and the held-out LIBERO-Plus (76.5% and 51.8% against 71.2% and 45.4% for its backbone), exceeds the strongest baseline by 12.7 points on long-horizon tasks, and raises real-robot success from 40.0% to 60.0%. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Zuzuzzy/NS-VLA.
papers.summary: 视觉-语言-动作模型把自然语言指令落到画面上再输出动作，但在长程任务里，主干往往看不见指令的结构，泛化也容易被底座绑死。一种神经符号方法先把指令解析成原语计划，用门控单调阶段指针跟踪当前子指令，再让分块策略只以当前子指令为条件。训练上先在演示片段上拟合指针，再用经过成功过滤的在线学习细化动作策略。即便演示很少，它在长程套件 LIBERO-Long 上达到 42.0，比最强基线高 12.7 分。真机成功率从 40.0% 提到 60.0%。==把指令的组合结构显式交给策略，长程操作才不必全靠底座自己去猜阶段。==

papers.title: GenPA: Image Generators as Efficient Robot Policies
papers.authors: Zian Deng, Tianyi Zhang, Zilong Zheng, Ziyu Liu, Tao Zhang, Yao Lyu, Shengbo Eben Li
papers.abstract: Pretrained visual generation models have shown great promise in robotic manipulation. However, a representative line of work still treats future visual prediction as the central link between visual generative pretraining and action learning, retaining it as a training objective even when future scenes are no longer generated at inference time. We argue that the instruction-following, spatial understanding, and visual imagination capabilities acquired through image generation pretraining can support control without future visual prediction: image generation models themselves can be directly adapted into powerful action learners. Building on this perspective, we propose GenPA, which fine-tunes an image generation backbone with a lightweight 19M-parameter action regression adapter and reuses its native generative objective for perception co-training. The native image-editing interface accommodates different visual targets without task-specific perception heads, enabling comparisons of current-scene perception, future prediction, and their combinations within a common policy architecture. At deployment, GenPA requires only a single backbone forward pass and action regression, without visual generation or iterative action denoising. Without additional large-scale robot-data pretraining, GenPA demonstrates strong control performance and robustness to perturbations across simulation benchmarks (99.10% success on LIBERO and 83.79% on LIBERO-Plus) and real-world manipulation tasks. Under compiled inference, GenPA takes 20.9 ms per action chunk on a single H100 GPU, achieving 1.7-3.4x speedups over strong VLA and WAM baselines. Our latency analysis further highlights architectural advantages of visual generation backbones for efficient robot control. Ablations across visual tasks and their combinations identify current-depth supervision as a simple, effective training recipe.
papers.summary: 一批把视觉生成模型用于机器人的工作，仍把预测未来画面当成对接控制的中心环节，即使推理时已经不再生成未来场景。图像生成预训练里学到的指令跟随、空间理解和视觉想象，其实可以直接变成动作学习，而不必再经过未来视觉预测。一种做法给图像生成主干接上轻量的动作回归适配器，并复用其原生生成目标做感知共训；部署时只需一次主干前向和动作回归，不必做视觉生成或迭代动作去噪。无需额外的大规模机器人数据预训练，它在 LIBERO 上成功率达到 99.10%，在分布外的 LIBERO-Plus 上达到 83.79%；编译推理后，单块动作在一颗 H100 上耗时 20.9 毫秒。

papers.title: Revisiting Embodied Chain-of-Thought for Generalizable Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Nan Sun, Yuan Zhang, Yongkun Yang, Wentao Zhao, Peiyan Li, Jun Guo, Wenxuan Song, Pengxiang Ding, Runze Suo, Yifei Su, Xin Xiao, Xinghang Li, Huaping Liu
papers.abstract:
Embodied chain-of-thought (CoT) aims to bridge linguistic reasoning with robotic control, yet its effective form and integration remain underexplored. In this paper, we revisit embodied CoT for robotic control at an unprecedented scale.
We curate the largest embodied CoT corpus to date, comprising 978,743 trajectories, 226.3M samples, and 2592.5 hours of data.
Through extensive experiments, we show that effective CoT must ground high-level semantic understaning in concrete linguistic action guidance -- such as end-effector movement and image-space trajectories -- whereas high-level reasoning alone yields marginal gains.
More importantly, we identify that explicit CoT does not scale reliably as an autoregressive action prefix, suffering from compounding errors during inference. To address these challenges, we propose ERVLA, a vision-language-action (VLA) model that effectively leverages linguistic reasoning in generalizable robot manipulation. ERVLA is trained using a CoT-dropout strategy, allowing the model to leverage rich reasoning traces during training while predicting actions directly without CoT during inference to bypass autoregressive instability.
This approach enables reliable scaling with increasing pre-training data. ERVLA achieves state-of-the-art results on LIBERO-Plus with an 86.9% success rate and reaches 53.2% on VLABench, showcasing superior performance in out-of-distribution settings.
Furthermore, ERVLA outperforms competitive state-of-the-art baselines in real-robot experiments, especially in handling semantic ambiguity and long-horizon tasks.
papers.summary: 具身思维链想把语言推理接到机器人控制上，但怎样写、怎样用，一直缺少大规模检验。一项研究整理了迄今最大的具身思维链语料，包含 978,743 条轨迹，并用实验表明：有效的思维链必须把高层语义落到具体的语言动作引导上，比如末端如何移动、图像空间里的轨迹，只有高层推理时增益有限。更关键的是，把显式思维链当作自回归动作前缀，推理时误差会累积，不能可靠放大。新模型在训练时对思维链做随机丢弃，推理时直接预测动作，从而绕开这种不稳定。它在 LIBERO-Plus 上成功率达到 86.9%，在 VLABench 上达到 53.2%。

papers.title: FoRe: A Force-Guided Framework for Autonomous Grasp Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Shuai Peng, Yongkai Liao, Yuxin Cheng, Haoyuan Wang, Jian Huang
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong performance in grasp-based manipulation, yet reliable recovery from local grasping failures remains challenging. Specifically, in pick-and-place tasks, policies may continue transport after a failed grasp instead of retrying, potentially reflecting overreliance on proprioceptive cues for stage progression and limited retry supervision. Existing recovery approaches typically rely on deployment-time guidance or demonstration augmentation. We introduce Force-guided Recovery (FoRe), a framework for autonomous recovery from local grasping failures. Using force feedback, FoRe partitions demonstrations into approach-grasp and transport-placement stages to train separate policies. To supplement limited retry supervision, FoRe then initializes a dedicated retry policy from the approach-grasp policy and refines it through local reinforcement learning (RL) from post-failure states. To avoid inappropriate stage progression, a controller combines force feedback with grasp-command status at inference to coordinate the stage policies, detect grasp failures, and invoke the retry policy. We also construct LIBERO-SUCTION, a force-augmented suction manipulation benchmark adapted from LIBERO, with complete demonstration trajectories for policy training. FoRe consistently improves task success rates for VLA-Adapter and $\pi_{0.5}$ on LIBERO-SUCTION, LIBERO, and real-world tasks. On LIBERO-SUCTION, average absolute gains are 18.4% and 6.5%, respectively. The corresponding real-world absolute gains are 25.0% and 21.7%. FoRe also remains effective with only one demonstration per task on both simulation benchmarks.
papers.summary: 视觉-语言-动作模型做抓取操作已经比较强，但局部抓取失败后往往不会自己重试，可能直接进入搬运，像是过早相信本体感觉、也缺少重试监督。现有补救多半靠部署时人工引导，或把演示再增强。一种力引导方法用力反馈把演示切成接近-抓取和搬运-放置两段，分别训练策略，再从接近-抓取策略初始化专门的重试策略，在失败后的状态上做局部强化学习；推理时由控制器结合力信号和抓取指令状态来切换，并在失败时调用重试。在带力信号的吸盘操作基准 LIBERO-SUCTION 上，两款底座的平均成功率绝对提升分别为 18.4% 和 6.5%；真机上最高达到 25.0%。

papers.title: Learning from Incomplete Actions: Interval Motion Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.authors: Yunpeng Mei, Chenyu Wang, Xiaowen Zhu, Chenbo Xin, Hongjie Cao, Yiyuan Li, Chengye Zhang, YuAn Wang, Gang Wang
papers.abstract: Visual labeling of egocentric demonstrations often leaves contiguous gaps in action supervision. Reliable poses around a gap still provide its net translation and rotation. We use this information to train vision-language-action policies while preserving ordinary flow matching on reliable local actions. A composition objective constrains the aggregate motion of missing-action estimates, combining multiple fixed windows when a gap exceeds the policy horizon. A shared interval branch learns from reliable endpoints and supplies the composition target. On LIBERO with 20% of demonstrations and 70.5% missing actions, the main method achieves 87.9% mean success over three training runs. In one paired comparison with matched observation exposure and training cost, its advantage over masking is 10.5%. On Ego-informed RoboTwin gaps, success is 45.4%, versus 40.3% for masking. On five real-robot tasks, mean success is 59.6%, versus 54.8% for interval flow matching alone and 48.8% for masking.
papers.summary: 用第一人称演示给视觉-语言-动作策略做标注时，动作监督常常出现连续缺口。缺口两端如果位姿还可靠，仍能知道这段净平移和净转动。一种方法在可靠的局部动作上照常做流匹配，再用组合目标约束缺口里估计动作的总位移。缺口长过策略视野时，就拼接多个固定窗口。共享的区间分支从可靠端点学习，并提供这个组合目标。在 LIBERO 上只用两成演示、且 70.5% 的动作缺失时，主方法三次训练的平均成功率为 87.9%。真机五项任务平均成功率为 59.6%，直接掩盖缺口的基线为 48.8%。

papers.title: PACE: Policy Augmentation and Compensation With Explicit Disturbance Estimation for Robust Locomotion
papers.authors: Shixuan Han, Yuyang Wang, Jingting Jia, Zeshuai Chen, Jindou Jia, Kexin Guo, Xiang Yu
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning has made quadrupedal locomotion remarkably robust. To handle unmodeled dynamics and external disturbances, domain randomization is usually employed to make a policy hedge against every condition it might meet. However, maintaining accurate tracking across varying dynamics and generalizing beyond the sampled range remain challenging. Here we show that explicitly estimating the disturbance and feeding the resulting estimation back into both the policy and the controller can relax this compromise. We introduce Policy Augmentation and Compensation with Explicit disturbance estimation (PACE). The framework lumps payload variations, center-of-mass (CoM) shifts, actuator degradation, and external forces into one joint-space disturbance. A nonlinear observer subsequently recovers this disturbance online without requiring joint acceleration measurements. The disturbance estimation provides feedforward torque compensation as the foundational control pathway and further augments the policy observation to enable disturbance-aware action generation. Considering the learning difficulty of fast-varying contact effects, we further provide an analytical contact estimation approach from joint and inertial measurements, without demanding force sensors. Across eleven simulated dynamics conditions, PACE reduces velocity-tracking error by 18.1% to 57.0% against state-of-the-art baselines, and maintains improved tracking under out-of-distribution (OOD) commands. Notably, in real-world experiments, the deployed real robot carried an 11.5 kg payload, nearly equal to its own mass. It also negotiated unseen 16 cm step-downs and crossed five outdoor terrains. The policy was trained exclusively on flat ground in simulation with at most 3 kg of added mass.
papers.summary: 四足行走的强化学习常用域随机化，让策略对可能遇到的每一种扰动都做对冲，但在变化的动力学里既要跟准速度，又要泛化到采样范围之外，仍然很难两全。一种框架把负载变化、质心偏移、执行器退化和外力收成一个关节空间扰动，用无须关节加速度的非线性观测器在线估计，再把估计既送给力矩前馈补偿，也送进策略观测。接触力可用关节和惯性测量解析估计，不必装力传感器。在十一种仿真动力学条件下，相对 BASELINE 和 HIMLOCO，速度跟踪误差分别降低 57.0% 和 18.1%。真机只在仿真平地上训练，却能负重 11.5 千克，接近自重，并跨过未见过的十六厘米台阶。

papers.title: ReActWAM: Action-Consistent Caching for Efficient World-Action Models
papers.authors: Zhaochen Guo, Yunke Wang, Siyu Xu, Zijian Wang, Chenghao Xia, Chengbin Du, Shinan Liu, Chang Xu
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) often generate future visual states alongside robot actions, introducing substantial computational overhead during inference. During closed-loop execution, consecutive inference cycles often predict similar action sequences, leading to redundant computation. However, reducing this redundancy requires distinguishing consistent actions from changes that demand fresh computation. To address these challenges, we propose ReActWAM, a training-free framework that combines action-intent-guided prefix skipping with inner-chunk prediction reuse. A coarse-to-fine assessment evaluates motion changes, visual consistency, and action prediction conflicts. For eligible chunks, we draw on first-step differences to adapt the cached latent and network features to the current condition, providing an estimate at a later denoising step that bypasses the redundant prefix. Subsequent inference refines this estimate while reusing stable denoising predictions within the chunk. Experiments across LingBot-VA, FastWAM and the Cosmos family on LIBERO-Long and RoboTwin 2.0 demonstrate $1.41\times$--$5.44\times$ GPU inference speedup, with minimal degradation in task success rates. Real-world experiments on a Franka Research 3 (FR3) robot further achieve $1.46\times$ end-to-end speedup while maintaining success rate.
papers.summary: 世界动作模型常在生成机器人动作的同时预测未来视觉状态，推理开销很大；闭环执行时相邻周期又常常预测出相近的动作序列，计算被重复掉。要省掉这些重复，必须分清哪些动作是连续一致的，哪些变化必须重新算。一种无需额外训练的方法用动作意图引导的前缀跳过和块内预测复用：先粗后细地看运动变化、视觉一致性和动作冲突，对合适的块根据首步差异改写缓存特征，从较后的去噪步接上，并复用块内稳定的预测。在 LIBERO-Long 和 RoboTwin 上，它给多类世界动作模型带来 1.41 倍到 5.44 倍的 GPU 推理加速，任务成功率下降很小；Franka 真机端到端加速 1.46 倍。

papers.title: SCAP: Stochastic Context for Action Expert Pretraining
papers.authors: Xiao Lin, Yaoxu Lyu, Ronghao Dang, Zhili Liu, Kaijing Ma, Yang Zhou, Dingning Liu, Runzhe Teng, Jun Cen, Shanghang Zhang, Chengju Liu, Qijun Chen
papers.abstract: Single-modality action-expert pretraining controls competition from visual shortcuts before vision--language--action (VLA) adaptation. Yet single-modality pretraining can impair the vision--language interactions needed for subsequent joint prediction. We construct a diagnostic model in which VA or LA pretraining can disable an initially active pathway for joint vision--language modeling. In this model, subsequent training with complete visual and language inputs cannot restore the pathway, even with unlimited adaptation. We therefore introduce Stochastic Context for Action Expert Pretraining (SCAP), a new action-expert pretraining stage that precedes full-input training. During this stage, visual and text tokens are randomly masked before entering the VLM. In this unified diagnostic model, SCAP can preserve the joint vision--language modeling pathway during pretraining and subsequent full-input training. Compared with direct full-input training, it can also reduce reliance on visual shortcuts and increase reliance on language instructions. SCAP consistently improves performance across four different VLA architectures. In real-robot experiments, it achieves 76.67% average success across three instruction-conditioned manipulation tasks, outperforming full-input pretraining by 25 percentage points.
papers.summary: 动作专家如果只用单模态预训练，虽能压住视觉捷径，却可能把后续联合预测所需的视觉-语言通路关掉。在一个诊断模型里，这条通路一旦被视觉-动作或语言-动作预训练关掉，即使再用完整输入、不限量地适配，也无法恢复。新的预训练阶段在进入全输入训练前，先把视觉和文本 token 在送进视觉语言模型之前随机掩码，从而保住联合通路，也能减少对视觉捷径的依赖、提高对语言指令的依赖。它在四种不同的视觉-语言-动作架构上都带来提升；真机三项按指令操作任务的平均成功率为 76.67%，比直接全输入预训练高出 25 个百分点。

papers.title: RoboTrack: Point tracking for real-world robotic manipulation
papers.abstract: We introduce RoboTrack, a benchmark and training data suite for point tracking in robotic manipulation.
papers.summary: 真实世界的机器人操作里，系统常常需要跟踪物体或接触点在画面中如何移动，才能跟上操作过程中的运动变化。要把这类点跟踪做成可训练、可比较的任务，需要同时有评测基准和可用于训练的数据。Ai2 推出了 RoboTrack，这是一套面向机器人操作中点跟踪任务的基准和训练数据套件。它把基准和训练数据放在一起，用来支持在机器人操作场景下训练点跟踪模型，并在同一套套件上比较不同方法。对做操作策略和视觉反馈的人来说，这意味着有了一份专门针对机器人操作点跟踪的公开资源，可以把训练和评测放在同一套数据上完成。
